description: Na₅MgSbO₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Mg and five O atoms. The Na-Mg bond length is 2.81 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Mg and five O atoms. The Na-Mg bond length is 2.89 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.85 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to two equivalent Mg and four O atoms to form distorted NaMg₂O₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaMg₂O₄ octahedra and edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both Na-Mg bond lengths are 2.41 Å. There are two shorter (2.33 Å) and two longer (2.45 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mg is bonded to six Na atoms to form MgNa₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgNa₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₅Sb octahedra, and edges with six ONa₄Sb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaMg₂O₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.02 Å) and two longer (2.41 Å) Sb-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₅Sb octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgNa₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₅Sb octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgNa₆ octahedra, and edges with five ONa₄Sb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-28°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Sb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Sb atoms to form ONa₄Sb₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₄Sb₂ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgNa₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent ONa₅Sb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
